newsitem.title: USA: Storage USA files shelf for $100 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Storage USA files shelf for $100 mln common.

text.p: Storage USA Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission Tuesday for up to $100 million in common stock.

The Columbia, Md.,-based self-storage facilities operator said it will contribute net proceeds to its operating partnership, SUSA Partnership L.P., in exchange for additional partnership units in SUSA.
The proceeds will then be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of debt, improvement of properties and acqusition of additional properties.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
